newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end up on expiry, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end up on expiry, more gains seen.

text.p: 1415 GMT - Austrian shares close firmer as March contract future expires. Traders see positive trend next week, provided market not hit by U.S. rate fears or uncertainty over European Economic and Monetary Union.
* ATX index up 7.10 or 0.59 percent at 1,216.60.
* 13 ATX shares higher, six lower, two unchanged.
* Top gainer microchip maker AMS up 5.31 percent at 1,091 ats
* Leading decliner luxury hosiery maker Wolford, down 3.14 percent at 390 ats.
* March ATX future up four points at 1,211 points.
